PLAN "12-Week Strength Return for Post-Meniscus Tear"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build lower and upper body strength for skiing, avoiding deep knee flexion and impact"

PHASES
  PHASE "Foundation & Mobility" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength":
        warmup:
          treadmill_walk 8m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press_partial_range 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise_machine 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stationary_bike 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 2m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Core & Stability":
        warmup:
          elliptical 6m
        main straight_sets:
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20s_each_side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12_each_side rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          standing_cable_anti_rotation_press 3x10_each_side rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
